description: This file is a shell script designed to install host system binaries and their related libraries into a specified directory, handling copying, linking, patching, and bundling shared libraries for executable files.

methods.name: _cp
methods.description: Copies files with error handling and verbose option.

methods.name: _mv
methods.description: Moves files with error handling and verbose option.

methods.name: _md
methods.description: Creates directories with error handling and verbose option.

methods.name: _ln
methods.description: Creates symbolic links with error handling and verbose option.

methods.name: _relpath
methods.description: Calculates relative path between two directories.

methods.name: _runas_so
methods.description: Builds a shared preload library that mangles the argument zero.

methods.name: _patch_ldso
methods.description: Patches dynamic linker binaries for library path adjustments.

methods.name: _patch_glibc
methods.description: Patches glibc binary files for locale and library path adjustments.

methods.name: should_be_patched
methods.description: Determines if a binary should be patched based on its type and properties.
